reason: The primary CIF parses and P2_1-expands to a fully occupied 40-atom Na4Sc2In2Si8O24 cell (reduced Na2ScIn(SiO3)4, Z=2) with the stated 9.877918 x 9.207537 x 5.422018 angstrom, beta=104.310501 degree primitive cell and explicit Sc/In ordering. All 93 observed reflections with prominence at least 1 are matched within 0.04 degree 2theta, with no important unexplained line. An independent instantiated whole-profile comparison gives R=6.81% and correlation 0.99756 versus a 4.60% Pawley NNLS lower bound; under the same profile model, concrete Sc/In alternatives are decisively worse (disordered centrosymmetric parent 12.54%, inversion-paired ordering 20.04%, glide-paired ordering 29.01%). The trace also documents converged restrained coordinate refinement rather than a position-only prototype match. Periodic checks find no overlaps, SiO4 distances of 1.622-1.631 angstrom, complete Sc/InO6 shells of 2.083-2.190 angstrom, a sensible extended Na shell, balanced formal charge, and bond-valence-consistent oxidation assignments. Primitive standardization reveals no different cell, and no concrete diffraction-compatible ordering, occupancy, symmetry, or framework ambiguity remains, so another attempt is unlikely to add a materially different viable candidate.
